scope: Independent offline integration tests and code/workflow audit. No network, paid API, secrets read, commit, push, or deployment.

audit.public_priority: Public HTML succeeds without CLI; existing summaries are skipped and preserved.
audit.identity: Exact normalized requested DOI required; mismatched graph refused; node kind labels retained.
audit.privacy: Summary request uses whitelisted title/type/excerpt/evidence; synthetic private item and CLI account envelope sentinels absent from resulting evidence/receipts; archive basis only kind/url/sha256/chars and raw text rejected.
audit.budget: Daily whole-run allowance reserved durably; same-day rerun exhausted, next-day reset; malformed/future ledger and missing key grant zero. Failed calls consume allowance. Git push precedes GITHUB_OUTPUT; push failure blocks paid stage. Shared concurrency group cancel-in-progress:false serializes this workflow. Crash after push wastes reservation rather than reclaiming it.
audit.bounds: Max items24/configured tested3, max_chars24000/configured12000, timeout30/configured12; HTML stream rejects >2MB; CLI stdout spooled to auto-cleaned temp file, response >2MB rejected before JSON parse, CLI timeout60.
audit.upstream: Site-only enrichment and SMTP config removed from upstream YAML.

fixed_findings.issue: Malformed date ledger could reset allowance
fixed_findings.resolution: Strict ISO date validation added by main agent; independent malformed-ledger regression passed.

fixed_findings.issue: CLI capture_output could load unbounded envelope into RAM
fixed_findings.resolution: Main agent changed to TemporaryFile spool and 2MB parse guard; oversize regression passed.

limits: Offline mock evidence verifies contract; it does not prove live Bohrium credentials, current CLI service response or extraction coverage.
Daily cap applies to the serialized repository workflow and its tracked ledger; unrelated external calls or manual ledger deletion are outside this accounting.
CLI spool limits parsing/RAM and execution time; the temporary file can grow until process termination (60 seconds).
